title: populationgenomics/popgen_rbceq2 pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow port of RBCeq2: blood group genotyping from gVCFs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the pipeline finds input gVCFs and writes results.

cohorts.description: Comma-separated Metamist cohort IDs to fetch gVCFs for (e.g. COH11572,COH11598).

metamist_project.description: Metamist project to query for cohort gVCF analyses.

use_metamist.description: Build the input samplesheet from Metamist (production). If false, use the gvcfs glob (local/dev).

gvcfs.description: Glob for input gVCFs, used for local/dev runs when use_metamist is false.

outdir.description: Output directory where results will be saved. Use an absolute cloud path.

output_version.description: Version label inserted into the output path (e.g. v1, v2) so re-runs don't overwrite each other.

reference_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_options.description: Reference genome build for variant calling.

reference_genome.description: Reference genome build passed to rbceq2.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images for each process (Artifact Registry paths).

rbceq2_container.description: Container image for the RBCEQ2 process.

bcftools_container.description: Container image for the CONVERT (bcftools) process.

metamist_container.description: Container image for the BUILD_SAMPLESHEET (Metamist query) process.
